Hi, I'm Kae! I'm currently pursuing a Master of Business Analytics at Monash University as an Australia Awards Mekong–Australia Partnership (AA-MAP) Scholar.

With a background in chemistry and polymer science, I have over six years of experience in R&D, market development, and product management in the chemical and manufacturing industries. My experience sparked an interest in using data to connect science and business and support better decisions.

I'm particularly interested in data analytics for sustainability, energy, and manufacturing. Through this blog, I hope to share what I'm learning and explore how data can be turned into clear, meaningful stories.
